SELECT DISTINCT PARAM_CODE, PARAM_VALUE, PARAM_NAME FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_CODE ELSE a.PARAM_CODE END PARAM_CODE, CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_NAME ELSE a.PARAM_NAME END PARAM_NAME, CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_VALUE ELSE a.PARAM_VALUE END PARAM_VALUE
LEFT JOIN T_SCHEDULE_PARAMS A ON a.mix_area = '0' AND a.DEL_FLAG = '0' LEFT JOIN T_SCHEDULE_PARAMS B ON A.Param_Code = b.param_code AND b.mix_area = #{mixArea, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND b.del_flag = 0 ) WHERE PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND PARAM_CODE = #{paramCode}
